findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment:
The following nonfood contact surfaces are observed to be in need of cleaning: 

1. FIRST REPEAT- The deli walk-in cooler fan covers. 
2. The walk-in cooler fan covers in the meat room and the walk-in coolers on both sides of the meat department room. 
3. There is a large chunk of ice on the wall of the seafood department walk-in cooler. Ensure that this ice is removed and any issues are repaired to allow the wall to be smooth and easily cleanable. 

Ensure that nonfood contact surfaces are cleaned and maintained cleaned.
findings.citation_text: 4-602.13 Nonfood-Contact Surfaces. NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Sewage and waste water properly disposed.
findings.comment: There is a drain in the seafood department that is not draining any waste water. The PIC of this department stated that they squeegee the water to another drain due to the drain not draining. The PIC also stated that they have not noticed any sewage backing up. There has been a ticket put in for this issue, but the issue has not yet been repaired. A follow up is scheduled for 1/13/2026 (allows the store another day to get a company to come repair the drain) to ensure that the drain has been fixed and is sufficiently allowing waste water to drain.
findings.citation_text: 5-402.13 Conveying Sewage. SEWAGE shall be conveyed to the point of disposal through an APPROVED sanitary SEWAGE system or other system, including use of SEWAGE transport vehicles, waste retention tanks, pumps, pipes, hoses, and connections that are constructed, maintained, and operated according to LAW.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: The top of the knife holder in the deli department was observed to be have food debris and soil residue on it. CORRECTED- The PIC cleaned it during the inspection and was educated on the importance of maintaining this clean. Ensure that food contact surfaces are cleaned and maintained cleaned.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Single use/single service articles are properly stored and used.
findings.comment: There were single service containers in the deli that were observed to not be inverted. CORRECTED- The PIC inverted the containers and was educating on keeping single service articles and utensils inverted to protect the food contact surface from contamination. Ensure that all single service articles and utensils are handled, displayed, and dispensed to prevent contamination to food and lip-contact surfaces.
findings.citation_text: 4-904.11(A) Kitchenware and Tableware. (A) SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES and cleaned and SANITIZED UTENSILS shall be handled, displayed, and dispensed so that contamination of FOOD- and lip-contact surfaces is prevented.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment:
The following nonfood contact surfaces are observed to be in need of cleaning: 

1. The bottom of the deli freezer is observed to have a build up of food debris. 
2. The deli walk-in cooler fans are observed to have a build up of dust and soil residue. 

Ensure that nonfood contact surfaces are cleaned and maintained cleaned.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.citation_text:
4-602.13 Nonfood-Contact Surfaces. NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

The walk-in cooler fans in the meat department and the seafood department were observed to have a build up of dust accumulation. Ensure that nonfood contact surfaces are cleaned at a frequency necessary to prevent accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. 

The mop sink in the shared dish area between the deli and the bakery, the triple sink in the meat department, and the left of the triple sink in the shared dish area between the deli and the bakery are all observed to need re-caulked. The caulking is in a state of disrepair in each area. Ensure that these areas are re-caulked by next routine inspection. Physical facilities should be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-602.13: The bottom of the deli prep cooler is observed to have spilled sauce on it. Ensure that nonfood contact surfaces are cleaned as often as necessary. 

NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
FIRST REPEAT- Coving has fallen off the wall in the cheese area of the deli under the 3 compartment sink and under the handsink. Reattach coving so the wall is sealed to the floor.
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. [C]

findings.title: Utensils, equipment & linens: properly stored, dried, & handled
findings.comment:
Single-service spoons available for customers at the deli counter were observed with the food contact ends up. Discard potentially contaminated single-service spoons. Ensure utensils are presented so that only handles are touched by employees or customers.
4-904.11: (B) UTENSILS not prewrapped shall be presented so only handles are touched by EMPLOYEES and/or CONSUMERS. (C) SINGLE-SERVCIE ARTICLES intended for FOOD- and lip-contact shall be furnished for CONSUMER with wrapper or APPROVED dispenser. [C]
